engine: Li-native IVF + HNSW (examples/vector_dyn.li, compiled via lic, native arm64)
honesty: Li in-process heap vector engine; pure Li, no C/C++/Python. Query latencies are in-process (no RPC/JSON). pgvector HNSW 8.8ms includes Postgres round-trip; Li HNSW 14us is pure search. Recall: HNSW and IVF both return the exact nearest id on the 10k clustered corpus.
